# KabatOne

> KabatOne is a unified public safety platform for governments, municipalities, and emergency-response agencies. Its core is K-Dispatch, an AI-assisted computer-aided dispatch (CAD) and 911 system for multi-agency police, fire, and EMS response, connected natively to video management (VMS), AI video analytics, GIS, field units, and IoT sensors in one command-center platform. K-Dispatch powers Mexico's largest 911 center (100+ connected agencies). Primary markets: Mexico, Latin America, and the United States. Founded 2004.

## K-Dispatch — CAD / 911 dispatch (primary product)
- [K-Dispatch](https://kabatone.com/k-dispatch) ([español](https://kabatone.com/es/k-dispatch)): AI-assisted computer-aided dispatch. One queue for voice 911, text-to-911, multimedia messages, radio, citizen app, and IoT alerts; automatic triage and priority; AI unit recommendations; GIS and AVL tracking with live routing; mobile responder app.
- Multi-agency: police, fire, medical, and traffic departments work the same incident on one platform. Powers Mexico's largest 911 center with 100+ connected agencies.
- Integrations: radio systems (P25, TETRA, DMR), records management systems, VMS, LPR, facial recognition, gunshot detection, drone feeds. Open APIs and standard protocols (CAP, NIEM, NENA i3); layers onto existing call handling and radio, no rip-and-replace.
- Deployment: cloud, on-premises, or hybrid. Typical deployment 8–16 weeks, phased, with the existing CAD running in parallel until cut-over.
- Differentiator vs standalone CAD: dispatch, video, GIS, and sensors share one data model, so an incident created in dispatch appears on the map with the assigned unit and the corresponding live video.

## What KabatOne does
- Unifies siloed public safety systems (video, dispatch, GIS, sensors) into one operational platform (the "Avalon" unified platform / C5 command-center model).
- Aggregates cameras from any manufacturer (Hikvision, Axis, Dahua, Bosch, Hanwha), adds AI video analytics (LPR, behavior, forensic search), and correlates alerts with CAD dispatch and a live GIS map.
- Products: K-Dispatch (CAD / 911 dispatch), K-Video (VMS + AI video analytics), K-Safety (situational awareness), K-Traffic (intelligent traffic management), K-Connect (public-private camera integration).

## Products
- [K-Dispatch — CAD / 911 dispatch](https://kabatone.com/k-dispatch): Computer-aided dispatch with AI-assisted unit recommendations, NG911 readiness, and native video/GIS integration.
- [K-Video — AI video platform](https://kabatone.com/k-video): Video management (VMS) plus AI analytics across any-brand cameras.
- [K-Safety — situational awareness](https://kabatone.com/k-safety): Unified operational picture across video, sensors, and field units.
- [K-Traffic — intelligent traffic management](https://kabatone.com/k-traffic): Adaptive signal control, congestion and incident detection.
- [K-Connect — public-private camera integration](https://kabatone.com/k-connect): Connects business and citizen cameras to the command center.

- [What is a Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC)?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-a-real-time-crime-center): Integrating live video, analytics, LPR, and gunshot detection.
- [Best RTCC Software — vendors compared](https://kabatone.com/resources/rtcc-software): Real-time crime center software buyer's guide; vendors (Axon/Fusus, Genetec, Hexagon, Mark43, Milestone, Motorola, Verkada) compared vs KabatOne's unified platform; selection criteria and cost.
- [What is a Public Safety Platform?](https://kabatone.com/resources/what-is-a-public-safety-platform): Unifying products, industries, and integrations into one topical platform.
